vibe_rationale: Non-profit, curated, artist-led publishing fair with deep trust in its art community; one scene and a quieter format than SURPLUS.
fit_notes: Adult, design-literate artists, designers and collectors, with weak wellness adjacency and no health-sector precedent. Programme collaborators and a venue partner only, with no sponsor list or partnership contact published. A reading lounge, zine collaboration or publishing commission would fit better than sampling. US-based.
